_meta.purpose: Promotion-only path binding map. Extracted from real UILotteryPromotion prefab bundle, IL2CPP RVAs, Unity AnimatorController/AnimationClip data, and SimpleTweenTMPSage bytes.
_meta.status: binding artifact; visual parity must still be verified against real game frames

UICharacterAcquisitionAnimationPresenter.sets: UILotteryPromotion.Entity.sePlayer, btnScreen, btnSkip, startRarity, fixRarity, callback
UICharacterAcquisitionAnimationPresenter.viewRarityNotes: Promotion view is called for each CharacterAcquisitionElement; rarity/pattern logic decides startRarity and fixRarity. First five-star on IsPromotionFiveStar pattern uses SR->SSR morph. SSRUltimatePlusPU is selected for qualifying UltimatePlus pickup branch per entity construction.

UILotteryPromotion.Set.sets: entity backing field then calls OnSet()

UILotteryPromotion.OnSet.sets: root animator layers 0 and 1 to state Default at time 0

conditions: SR current + SSR fix -> play SSRPromotion on root animator layer 1
SR current + SSRUltimatePlusPU fix -> play SSRUltimatePlusPUPromotion on root animator layer 1
current == fix -> play FixRarity + fixRarity.ToString() on layer 1

UILotteryPromotion.StopAllTextAnim.sets: all textAnimatorList Back/Front/Middle Animators to state Default at time 0; controller state Default uses TextDefault clip
